faqs.question: How to subscribe to your Hello Plan?
faqs.answer: In the Hello panel, click on the subscription tab, that is available on the left corner. It will open the page of the current plan and also the option to purchase a new plan. Click on that and you will be able to select from monthly and yearly options. You can directly subscribe to the plan from the website itself. There go to hello service and click on get started, and fill the necessary details and subscribe to the plan.

You can use the chat bot in a free plan till 50 tickets in Hello, after that you have to upgrade your hello plan. Basically we are providing the chat Bot free for Trial purposes. You can use this Chat Bot in Whatsapp, Instagram, Chat Widget on your Website, Facebook and so on. So test the Chat Bot Now.

faqs.question: Do I get 5000 free emails only once or every month?
faqs.answer: With the free plan subscription, you will receive 5000 free emails every month.

faqs.question: I purchased the starter plan and received 100,000 emails for a month. What if my email traffic exceeds 100,000 in a month?
faqs.answer: In the starter plan, you get 100,000 emails and 100 email validations. If you send more than 100,000 emails in a month, you will be charged an additional 0.02/- per email. Additionally, if you perform more than 100 email validations, you will be charged 0.25/- per validation. This amount will be deducted from your MSG91 wallet. The Extra section in every email plans displays this information.

faqs.question: In the plan I bought, there are two limits: a Monthly Spending Limit and a Postpaid Billing Limit. Could you explain the difference between them and how they're used?
faqs.answer: You, as the user, can set the monthly spending limit, while the postpaid billing limit can only be set by the MSG91. If you have exhausted the emails and validations allotted according to your subscribed plan and wish to send more emails or validate additional email IDs, MSG91 will deduct the excess usage amount from your wallet when you reach 90% of your postpaid billing limit. After this deduction, your postpaid billing limit will reset to the default. If your consumption continues and reaches 90% of your postpaid billing limit again, another deduction will occur from your wallet. In this situation, the total maximum deduction aligns with the monthly spending limit you've set.

faqs.question: I am a free plan user, and I don't get any email validations in it. How can I use validations?
faqs.answer: If you want to go beyond the benefits provided in any plan, check the extra section of that plan for details. To use email validation in the free plan, you'll need to pay 0.35 per email validation, which will be deducted from your MSG91 wallet.

faqs.question: I subscribed to the starter plan, which should give me 1 Lac emails at 2000/-. However, after subscribing, I noticed that the deducted amount was less than 2000, and I received fewer than 1 Lac emails.
faqs.answer: Each plan operates on a monthly basis, starting from the first date to the last. If you purchase a plan in the middle of the month, the system will calculate charges and benefits on a pro-rated basis, considering the remaining days in the month.

faqs.question: What is the MSG91 WhatsApp Business API pricing in India?
faqs.answer:
MSG91 WhatsApp Business API platform starts with a ₹0 subscription fee for the initial two months. After that, you pay just ₹500 a month for each WhatsApp number.

WhatsApp messages are charged separately, at the same price Meta charges. MSG91 adds nothing on top. WhatsApp messaging charges are based on the recipient’s country and message category, including Marketing, Utility, Authentication, Service, and Authentication International. 18% GST applies.

faqs.question: Does MSG91 charge extra for WhatsApp templates, media, APIs, or other features?
faqs.answer:
No. With MSG91, there is no extra charge for creating templates, sending images or documents, using APIs and webhooks, or turning on WhatsApp Coexistence for eligible numbers.

WhatsApp message logs for the last 100 days are free. If you need older logs, up to one year, you can ask for them at an extra cost. You only pay the normal message charges, the platform fee and taxes. Check WhatsApp message logs.

faqs.question: What changed in WhatsApp Business pricing from October 1, 2026?
faqs.answer:
From October 1, 2026, Meta charges for replies you send on WhatsApp after a customer messages you. This includes agent replies, chatbot answers and Utility messages. Before this, they were free. Messages your customers send you are still free. MSG91 charges the same rate as Meta, with no markup.

MSG91 also helps you pay less. With MSG91 Chat Window, the chat goes on in one chat window, not as separate WhatsApp messages. So you pay for fewer messages. See how MSG91 lowers your cost.

faqs.question: Is there special pricing for sending millions of WhatsApp messages?
faqs.answer:
Yes. MSG91 offers enterprise pricing for businesses that send thousands & millions of WhatsApp messages every month. This covers Marketing, Utility, Authentication and Service messages. When you send a high volume of Utility and Authentication messages, Meta’s rates for those messages may drop. MSG91 passes this on to you with no extra markup.

For very high volumes, our sales team can build a custom plan around your messages and needs. Contact MSG91 Sales to get your enterprise WhatsApp price.

faqs.question: Are failed WhatsApp messages, automatic retries, and SMS or RCS fallback charged separately?
faqs.answer:
With MSG91, failed WhatsApp messages are not charged. You pay only for messages that are successfully sent, and incoming WhatsApp messages are free.

When MSG91 automatically retries a failed message, you pay only if the retry is successfully sent, at the normal WhatsApp rate.

If you use RCS as a fallback, you pay only when the RCS message is successfully sent. Failed RCS messages are not charged. SMS fallback is charged at the normal SMS rate for every message sent.

faqs.question: Can I control my WhatsApp spend so it never goes over budget?
faqs.answer: Yes. With MSG91, you can control WhatsApp costs for every number from one account. Add a prepaid balance to each number, set a monthly spending limit, and turn on auto-recharge so messages never stop. Each number costs ₹500 a month after the initial two months, plus message charges and 18% GST. So every team knows exactly what it spends. Any unused prepaid balance carries forward to the next month, as long as your subscription is active. Learn about prepaid billing.

faqs.question: Is the WhatsApp chatbot free with MSG91?
faqs.answer:
Yes, to start. MSG91 gives you a WhatsApp chatbot at no extra cost on the Hello Free plan, for up to 50 tickets. MSG91 Hello is a customer support platform where your chatbots and agents handle every chat in one inbox. For more tickets, choose a paid plan: Basic at ₹1,500 a month with a ₹1,500 bot wallet, or Premium at ₹3,000 a month with a ₹3,000 bot wallet.

Rule-based bots do not use the bot wallet. AI chatbots use money from the bot wallet, billed as per the bot rate card. 18% GST and WhatsApp message charges are extra.

faqs.question: What is the WhatsApp Authentication International rate in India?
faqs.answer:
It is a higher price Meta charges for WhatsApp OTPs sent to Indian (+91) numbers by some businesses based outside India.

Normal OTP rate: ₹0.115 per message. International OTP rate: ₹2.4971 per message.

You pay the higher rate only if both are true: your business is based outside India, and in 30 days, you send more than 7.5 lakh messages that you start (not replies), to countries with this rate, from all your WhatsApp accounts together.

Meta tells you 30 days before it starts. After that, all your OTPs cost the higher rate, even if you send fewer messages later. Businesses based in India always pay the normal rate.

See the countries on Meta's website | Check MSG91 WhatsApp pricing.

faqs.question: Can businesses set a maximum price for WhatsApp marketing messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. With MSG91’s Set Max Price feature, you choose the most you want to pay for each WhatsApp Marketing message. You can set a different limit for each country. To use it, open an approved Marketing template, choose Set Max Price under Template Pricing, and enter your limit. You may pay less than your limit. But if your limit is too low, some messages may not be delivered. You can change your limit or go back to Standard pricing at any time. Learn how WhatsApp bidding works.
